note: z/OS calibration probes (#4702 Part 2): our own fixed-format COBOL, runnable on Enterprise COBOL and on cobc -std=ibm. Run each on z/OS, record the result per entry in zos_calibration.json (key: probe id). oracle_expected is GnuCOBOL 3.1.2 -std=ibm output (gitgalaxy-gnucobol:3), measured 2026-10-22, DISPLAY lines in order. Never Hercules; results only after counsel clears licence and publishing (Q16).

c1-trunc-std.question: MOVE 99999 to S9(4) COMP and ADD 1 to 9999 with ON SIZE ERROR: IBM stores 9999 and raises the size error
c1-trunc-std.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. P1.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 B PIC S9(4) COMP.
       01 N PIC 9(6) VALUE 99999.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE N TO B
           DISPLAY "B1=" B
           MOVE 9999 TO B
           ADD 1 TO B
               ON SIZE ERROR DISPLAY "SE"
           END-ADD
           DISPLAY "B2=" B
           STOP RUN.
c1-trunc-std.note: Plain `cobc -std=ibm` behaves as TRUNC(BIN); the register's equivalence harness passes the TRUNC flag, so this row is the unflagged instrument, not the det port's answer.

c3-literal-truncated-to-zero.question: MOVE -1000 TO S9(3) (literal) and MOVE of the same value from a field: does the zero result keep its sign
c3-literal-truncated-to-zero.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. P3.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 S PIC S9(3).
       01 M PIC S9(4) VALUE -1000.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE -1000 TO S
           DISPLAY "S1=" S
           MOVE M TO S
           DISPLAY "S2=" S
           STOP RUN.
c3-literal-truncated-to-zero.note: The oracle folds the literal MOVE to +0 and keeps the sign for the field MOVE.

c4-unsigned-binary-below-zero.question: SUBTRACT past zero from an unsigned binary: IBM keeps the absolute value
c4-unsigned-binary-below-zero.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. P4.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 U PIC 9(4) COMP VALUE 3.
       01 Z PIC 9(4) COMP VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           SUBTRACT 5 FROM U
           DISPLAY "U1=" U
           SUBTRACT 1 FROM Z
           DISPLAY "Z1=" Z
           STOP RUN.
c4-unsigned-binary-below-zero.note: The oracle wraps; the det runtime follows IBM (C4, declared difference).

c13-edited-and-zoned-compare.question: Numeric-edited item against a number is compared as text; signed zoned item against an alphanumeric literal and against a number
c13-edited-and-zoned-compare.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. P13.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 E PIC ZZZ,ZZ9.99 VALUE ZERO.
       01 Z PIC S9(4) VALUE -12.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1500 TO E
           IF E > 1499 DISPLAY "E1=GT" ELSE DISPLAY "E1=NGT".
           IF Z = "0012" DISPLAY "Z1=EQ" ELSE DISPLAY "Z1=NE".
           IF Z = 12 DISPLAY "Z2=EQ" ELSE DISPLAY "Z2=NE".
           STOP RUN.
c13-edited-and-zoned-compare.note: Confirms the Language Reference's comparison-by-operand-class table on z/OS.

c14-size-error-zero-divisor.question: DIVIDE by zero with ON SIZE ERROR and 0 ** -1 with ON SIZE ERROR
c14-size-error-zero-divisor.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. P14.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 A PIC 9(4) VALUE 7.
       01 Z PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 R PIC 9(4) VALUE 55.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DIVIDE A BY Z GIVING R
               ON SIZE ERROR DISPLAY "SE1"
           END-DIVIDE
           DISPLAY "R1=" R
           COMPUTE R = Z ** -1
               ON SIZE ERROR DISPLAY "SE2"
           END-COMPUTE
           DISPLAY "R2=" R
           STOP RUN.
c14-size-error-zero-divisor.note: IBM says 0 ** -1 is a size error (the oracle returns 0 and takes no size error). Run only the ON SIZE ERROR forms: a bare zero divisor can abend S0CB.
